content:
amal: quick sanity check — ran bitsandbytes 8-bit weight-only on voyager13b with our standard eval suite (summaries_longform). results look weird.

ravi: what weird? numbers?

amal: throughput +15% vs fp16, latency down ~12% p50, but ROUGE-L dropped 3.6 points on long summaries. small prompts are fine.

sophie: did you use llanet or llm.int8 path? bnb sometimes does per-layer artifacts.

amal: bnb weight-only via transformers + bitsandbytes 0.39.2, quant config: --wbits 8 --bnb-use-gptq False. command:
```
python serve.py --model voyager13b --quant w8 --backend bitsandbytes
```

jen: tried llm.int8 recently? we saw better fidelity on chat slices but slower.

amal: ran llm.int8 fallback as well — quality better (ROUGE-L -1.1) but p50 latency +18% and GPU mem +1.2GB.

kai: can you share eval slice ids? maybe it's caching/warmup

amal: slice ids: longform_news, multi-paragraph-qa. Warmup profile: k=4 prefix length 128 helped. Also observed decoding token drift after 600 tokens.

maria: sounds like kv-cache and attention kernel differences. Did you try disabling continuous batching for the llm.int8 runs?

amal: yes. For llm.int8 I forced batch_size=1 and disable_async_batching. latency climbed but decodes matched fp16 more closely.

ravi: ops note: we should add a model profile for voyager13b-int8 with fallback to llm.int8 when ROUGE drop >2 on smoke slice. Also add canary traffic at 5%.

jen: +1. Add an automated eval step in rollout pipeline that runs longform slice and compares ROUGE/chrF. if regressions exceed threshold, auto-fallback.

sophie: for deployment, suggest quantized_v2 profile: prefer bitsandbytes for perf, fallback chain: llm.int8 -> fp16 on Dedicated. doc link: https://internal.redwood/models/quant-profiles

ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: voyager13b-int8-quant-profile (canary 5%, eval slice longform, rollback on ROUGE-L delta >=2.0)

amal: I'll push run artifacts to /mnt/experiments/voyager13b/int8/3076543210 and a short notebook with diffs.

ravi: thanks. schedule a quick sync tomorrow to decide defaults for Dedicated vs Hosted.

sophie: FYI: raise issue to track bitsandbytes 0.40 regression we've seen on attention reordering.

jen: noted. tagging @security for KMS test? (we store model slices)

maria: thanks everyone. closing thread unless new signals appear. :party_parrot:
